name: Breakfast with Santa at Brimstone
venue: Brimstone Woodfire Grill, The Shops at Pembroke Gardens
address: The Shops at Pembroke Gardens, Pembroke Pines, FL
paras: The Shops at Pembroke Gardens lists a PembrokeKIDS Breakfast with Santa at Brimstone on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 AM to 2 PM. Families sit down to breakfast with Santa at the restaurant, and the listing promises a festive morning of holiday cheer and creative fun.

Little ones can color, decorate and make their own Christmas ornaments to take home as a keepsake. Reservations are required, and the shopping center asks families to call Brimstone directly to reserve a spot. No price is printed on the listing, so ask when you call.
tip: Call Brimstone early to reserve, since seats are by reservation only.
